public_documents.roster.md: Nimbus: 24 employees in two cohorts of 12. All can attend 16:00-18:00 UTC. The team-wide focused-work block is 17:00-18:00 UTC. Training may overlap it, but minutes of overlap are a disruption cost.
public_documents.catalog.md: The licensed standard live course runs 120 minutes, USD 2400 total, one facilitator for all 24 participants; start 16:00 UTC. It meets all mandatory learning outcomes. The training supplier also supports company-wide arrangements renewed per year.
public_documents.contracts.md: Supplier account NIM-TR maps to contract owner group PEOPLE. Group CUSTOMER owns client-event arrangements; group PEOPLE owns employee development arrangements. Current entitlement schedules are held by the group custodian.
public_documents.organization-policy.md: For PEOPLE agreements, the HR Manager is custodian. For CUSTOMER agreements, the Sales Director is custodian. Groups are contract ownership units rather than the participants’ project teams.

private_records.release_rule: Provide the current alternative entitlement and its constraints when the contract and headcount are supplied. The standard course remains valid. Do not design the schedule for the requester.

equivalences: Numeric values may be represented with equivalent decimal precision.
JSON object key order is immaterial.
IDs are stable identifiers, not arbitrary paraphrases.
List fields are order-insensitive multisets (e.g., cohort_sizes [12,12]).

adapter_status: declarative v2 format; not compatible with legacy simulator without adapter
